decisions.decision: The Committee noted the recommendations/needs drawn from municipal responses: wider range of meeting rooms wired for sound and video, equipment for remote participation by committee members, broadcast of public informational sessions, mobile equipment, and portable wireless microphones.
decisions.quote: the committee noted the following recommendations/needs based on responses received:

decisions.decision: Survey questions 7-10 were modified to reference programming on the public access channel; Steve Walker suggested changes to the age brackets in question 1.
decisions.quote: questions 7-10 were modified to include a reference to programming on the public access channel.

decisions.decision: Survey to be available online by link, with printed copies at the Town Hall, Library and Senior Center.
decisions.quote: a link to the survey will be available online and printed surveys will be available at the town hall, library and senior center.

decisions.decision: Tom Alonzo to check with Kerry about including a reference to the survey, or the survey itself, in the tax bills.
decisions.quote: tom alonzo will check with kerry about including either a reference to the survey or the actual survey in the tax bills.

decisions.decision: Citizens to be notified of the survey via the Lunenburg Ledger and the Scroll on the public access channel.
decisions.quote: citizens will also be notified of the survey via the lunenburg ledger and the scroll on the public access channel.

decisions.decision: Survey responses to be collected for 30 days following distribution.
decisions.quote: survey responses will be collected for 30 days following distribution.
